scenario.description:
Canonical EvidenceForge iteration-test scenario for fast generate/evaluate/fix cycles. It
preserves the expanded environment and attack narrative while including authored,
transport-correlated IDS assertions, sensor-local filtering, cross-platform SMB activity,
a second domain controller, centralized monitoring, and deliberate no-alert cases for broad
automated and LLM-as-a-judge quality evaluation.
Meridian Healthcare Solutions is a mid-size healthcare IT company providing EHR
integration services from a corporate HQ with an on-premises data center. The
storyline compresses an APT-style web-app intrusion, Linux and Windows lateral
movement, credential theft, domain compromise, C2, DNS tunneling, data staging,
exfiltration, email abuse, and cleanup into a 6-hour collection window while
preserving broad event-type and log-format coverage. This expanded variant adds
explicit on-prem email topology, SMTP routing, corpus-backed message bodies,
MIME artifacts, distribution groups, Bcc handling, STARTTLS visibility, ISP relay
egress, inbound/outbound/internal mail, explicit mailbox reads, rejected mail,
and deterministic background email traffic. This benchmark epoch also adds one
representative benign cleartext multipart support upload through the explicit proxy.
This canonical epoch includes two macOS 27 arm64 engineering workstations and substantial
local-terminal, GUI, browser-helper, SSH and explicit system-job activity. The original
six-hour mixed-fleet workload is retained; its date moves to a supported Mac epoch.
